bitcoin_articles.headline: Grayscale Investments Deposits Bitcoin to Coinbase Prime
bitcoin_articles.summary: Grayscale Investments has deposited 1,863 Bitcoin into its Coinbase Prime institutional custody accounts.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Launches iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF (BITA)
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock has launched the iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF (BITA), an exchange-traded product designed to provide Bitcoin exposure while generating monthly income through option premiums.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Launches iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock has officially launched the iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF (BITA), a new fund designed to provide income-focused investors with exposure to Bitcoin through an options-based strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Hyperscale Data Updates Bitcoin and Cash Treasury Holdings
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. reported its updated treasury holdings as of June 14, 2026, including 713.5884 Bitcoin, 10,000 ounces of silver, and approximately $40.2 million in cash and restricted cash.

bitcoin_articles.headline: AVAX One Announces AI Inference Pilot at Redwater Facility
bitcoin_articles.summary: AVAX One Technology Ltd. is launching an AI inference pilot program at its Redwater facility to test converting 100 kilowatts of excess Bitcoin mining capacity to AI workloads.
